item.title: Insights from AusBiotech 2019 and Pharmaceutical Machinery Innovations
item.description:
Insights from AusBiotech 2019 and Pharmaceutical Machinery Innovations
#

Every year, AusBiotech serves as a pivotal gathering point for leaders and stakeholders in the Australian and international biotechnology sectors. The 2019 conference, held in Melbourne from October 30 to November 1 at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC), provided three days dedicated to education, skill development, and networking. This event is recognized for fostering reflection on industry achievements and facilitating the exchange of ideas to propel the sector forward both nationally and globally.

item.title: Pharmaceutical Innovation and Manufacturing at INTERPHEX 2021
item.description:
Pharmaceutical Innovation and Manufacturing at INTERPHEX 2021
#

The International Pharmaceutical Expo (INTERPHEX) stands as a premier event for professionals in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. Dedicated to innovation, technology, and knowledge sharing, INTERPHEX brings together global industry leaders, suppliers, and professionals to address the most pressing challenges in product development and manufacturing.
